artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the nose leather appears slightly overly smooth and plastic-like compared to real macro photography. There are faint smudging artifacts around the nostrils where the dark speckles blend into the pink skin.

The whiskers lack individual strand definition in some areas, appearing fused or melted into the background blur. The edge of the lower jaw blends softly into the background in a way that suggests slight generative smoothing rather than optical depth of field.
The inner corners of the eyes are slightly indistinct. The transition from the eyeball to the eyelid/fur is not perfectly sharp, showing minor 'mushing' typical of AI generation.
